dataset.frame_order: before slots 0,1,2; after slots 0,1,2; official list order, not filename order
dataset.viewpoint_note: Official files mix numeric views 0/1/2 and left/right/wrist. Slots are positional; front is only a legacy alias for slot 0, not a calibrated camera claim.
dataset.scope: Real-robot subtask action-effect verification; no dense motion, timestamps, or failure-onset labels.

cv.protocol: exploratory leave-one-task-family-out CV; not official zero-shot benchmark

config.scaler: StandardScaler fitted inside each train fold

definitions.denominator: All selected samples, including missing/failed/invalid predictions.
definitions.macro_f1: Mean F1 over the fixed labels success and failure; abstentions are false negatives for their true class; undefined class F1 is zero.
definitions.balanced_accuracy: Mean of success recall and failure recall; undefined when either ground-truth class is absent.
definitions.selective_accuracy: Correct / answered only; secondary to accuracy and must be read together with coverage.

definitions.matching: Exact ordered before/after image SHA256 and camera-slot identity; instruction equality uses exact strings.
definitions.both_correct_rate: Both original labels predicted correctly / all eligible pairs, including pairs with missing or failed outputs.
definitions.same_binary_prediction: Both outputs are success/failure and equal; two abstentions are counted separately, never as answered agreement.
definitions.conflicts: Opposite labels for exactly the same task, subtask and ordered observations are reported outside the instruction-change score; other pairs involving these samples remain explicitly flagged.

limits: Pairs can share samples and observations; pair count is not an independent sample size.
This diagnostic does not change selection, fitting, hyperparameters, or headline sample denominators.
No additional inference is run and no statistical significance or causal interpretation is claimed.
No eligible pairs yields null rates, not a zero or perfect score.

limits: This measures two-state subtask outcome verification, not continuous motion or failure-onset localization.
UR5 includes counterfactual instructions and altered state pairs; 140 rows are not 140 independent robot rollouts.
Task-family cross-validation probes are exploratory, not an official zero-shot OOD leaderboard score.
Base taskvar groups can contain similar or identical task meanings across groups; exact-image separation is not semantic OOD separation.
Reversed inputs are a corruption diagnostic scored against original labels, not labeled reverse-action trajectories.
No robot control, policy training, real-time deployment, or causal failure diagnosis is demonstrated.
